answer: Every claim climbs the meadow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the nectar re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The voyage of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, split across independent auditors, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
